verdict.rationale: OpenClaw ships an official `openclaw` CLI with a documented reference (probe-5). The docs show many agent-relevant subcommands: `openclaw mcp serve`, `openclaw skills` (search/install/update/verify), `openclaw security audit`, `openclaw fleet`, and ClawHub install commands. The install docs also treat the CLI as the default path, with desktop apps as the alternative. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage, and evidence of machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output for scripting.
